name: Harvest of the Best
source:
"Harvest of the Best" is a short visual novel with some smut scenes. Basic gameplay is focused on collecting ingredients to make various meals, but there are semi-hidden routes that will lead to NSFW content.

The game follows protagonist Oscar spending a weekend with a very good friend. Mimar is an immortal monster who enjoys good food and company. Over several days, collect and combine ingredients that appease Mimar's tastes.

There are four possible endings, and a lot of ingredients/combinations that can lead you there.
translation:
《收获最好的》是一部简短的视觉小说，其中有一些色情场景。基本游戏的重点是收集原料来制作各种食物，但也有一些半隐藏的路线可以通向NSFW内容。

游戏讲述了主角奥斯卡与一位好朋友度过一个周末的故事。米马尔是一个不朽的怪物，喜欢美食和陪伴。在几天的时间里，收集并混合满足米马尔口味的原料。

有四种可能的结局，以及许多可以引导你到达那里的成分/组合。
